caption: The drawing features a circular design with a scalloped edge, centered on a neutral beige background. The primary color used for the design is white. Within the circle, intricate patterns composed of interwoven, curved stems and branches are depicted. Leafy sprigs, floral motifs, and clusters of small round shapes resembling berries are distributed evenly throughout the composition. The center of the circle contains a basket filled with flowers, from which more stems and leaves emanate and disperse across the design. The entire circle is enclosed by a border formed by repeating, wave-like curves. Fine, diagonal linework fills the space between the floral patterns and the scalloped edge, creating a mesh-like texture. The lower left corner of the background contains a handwritten note in small cursive that reads, "centre detail no. 18467-6."
title: Bedspread
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
